mapper.select: SELECT u.user_id AS userId, u.username, u.password, u.phone, u.email, u.avatar, u.nickname, u.gender, u.status, ( SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT r.keyword SEPARATOR ',') FROM tb_jmz_user_role ur LEFT JOIN tb_jmz_role r ON ur.role_id = r.id WHERE ur.user_id = u.user_id ) AS role FROM tb_jmz_user u WHERE u.user_id = #{id}
